svg.title: A SIXEL band becomes one mask per color
svg.desc: An eight by six indexed pixel grid is split into separate blue and amber masks, then serialized as palette selections, mask runs, a carriage return, and a next-band command.
svg.text: A SIXEL band becomes one mask per color
Each output character carries six vertical paint bits; $ returns to the band origin.
Black cells set one or more of
the six bits in a SIXEL character.
The palette is already fixed here: -E only changes how these masks are serialized.
